description.value: This trouble ticket specification describes the characteristic and rules to apply when creating a Trouble Ticket...

value.description: The amount that is on dispute, it can be the entire charge amount or partial amount of the charge
value.name: disputeAmount

value.description: The positive amount to be credit, it can be equal or less than the dispute amount. In case credit is given a credit reason must be provided. In case no credit is given a reject reason must be provided
value.name: creditAmount

value.description: The reason for giving the credit, in case credit apply. In case no credit apply a reject reason must be provided
value.name: creditReason

value.description: The reason for rejecting the dispute, in case no credit apply.
value.name: rejectReason

value.description: Currency (ISO4217 norm uses 3 letters to define the currency)
value.name: currency

source.value: Adapted from the example payload 'TroubleTicketSpecification_retrieve_example_response' of the TMF621 Trouble Ticket 5.0.1 OpenAPI specification (TM Forum, Apache-2.0); illustrative data, not real operator data. Changes: people's names, e-mails and phone numbers replaced by fictitious ones, href/@schemaLocation URLs left out, references to entities of this candidate turned into NGSI-LD ids.
